uncertain: Terminal blocks (images 1-4): the USB-A and micro USB connectors sit in the middle of the board, so the USB-nearest rule gives no consistent start end (e.g. the temperature-probe block is nearly equidistant); all blocks were ordered left to right as displayed instead.

micro-usb-img5 / usb-a-img5 / ethernet-img5: these callouts list connector signals, not physical contact positions; order is the printed list order and it is unclear whether these receptacles belong in the connector list.
grove-img5: the Grove connector's physical pin order is not marked; the top-to-bottom callout order is assumed to match the connector pins.
notes: Images 1-4 show the same top-view terminal blocks (image 1 all, images 2-3 top row, image 4 bottom row); transcribed per image per rule 11. IN/OUT badges on power pins kept as functions. Port names (PJ11, PJ8, PH7, PA11...) used as labels where printed, with the board function name in functions. Group headings (POWER SUPPLY, ANALOG INPUTS, DIGITAL OUTPUTS...) omitted as category tags. Status LEDs and the RS485/CAN transceiver chip-pin callouts (U19, U15) in image 5 skipped. Image 6 J1/J2 are the board's Portenta sockets; 'I2C1 SD6' copied as printed. Tables in images 2-4 are explanatory and not transcribed.
